BILT was run for each pathway separately, so there was no competition between pathways for feedstock or for siting locations. A few pathways would compete for woody resources, which should be noted when looking at the following results. 5.1.3 Biomass Used There are several ways to analyze the results of the BILT model. Table 5-1 provides the ratios used. The ratio column indicates the number of gallons of biofuel needed to replace 1 gallon of conventional diesel fuel.
